hooks.name: Review deploy config on save
hooks.description: Checks Dockerfile, Cloud Build, Firebase, and rules files for Cloud Run/Firebase best practices and security.

action.prompt: A deployment config file was just saved. Review it against .kiro/steering/gcp-deployment.md and security.md: Cloud Run listens on $PORT, non-root user, /healthz, dedicated service account, no secrets inline (use Secret Manager), max-instances set, Firebase rewrites to Cloud Run correct, Security Rules deny by default, GCP services only (no AWS). Report issues briefly and fix clear mistakes; do not deploy.
